method: Complete Chinese/old-English comparison and full translation by the editor, followed by an independent full Chinese/new-English reread of all 170 paragraphs.

findings: Restored all 56 paragraphs and removed independent English additions about coercion/exclusion, group-reserved value and further claims about institutional history. Restored self-avoidance/self-enclosure pathology, the six-column table, divine/natural formation limits, boxing comparison, actual legislative research sequence and the previous book’s three explicit blanks.
anchors: Designation of self-friendship is suspended; its role as source remains active.
Ordered self-relation is source for Aristotle, only prerequisite for SAE; the outward branch remains a fresh judgment.
Private formation returns to legislative competence, rather than law being the sole direct route.
Cultivation is not an account of how a particular person is formed; efficacy remains assigned to the Second Critique.
The Ethics ends by beginning work, not simply relocating an unanswered question.

independent_review_corrections.before: So the shape of this debt must be stated precisely. It is not that he failed to write about formation, postponed the question one station further, or reached the end, pointed at an empty lot, and laid down his pen. He lays the chain all the way out. Only at its end does he discover that the question at its head cannot answer itself. So he turns the question into a work order and starts on it there and then.
independent_review_corrections.after: So the shape of this debt must be stated precisely. It is not that he failed to write about formation, postponed the question one station further, or reached the end, pointed at an empty lot, and laid down his pen. He lays the chain all the way out. Only at its end does he discover that he himself cannot answer the question at its head. So he turns the question into a work order and starts on it there and then.

findings: Restored all 60 source paragraphs, including the Book I/Book X lexical boundary, conditional strength of the fortune argument, ordinary skill/luck and domestic identity examples, precise translation caveat at the end, and both limits of self-portraiture. Removed added career/culture examples and added SAE recognition claims.
anchors: Book I settles origins unevenly; X.7–8 answers what happiness is, not how it arises.
Origin does not determine worth; Aristotle then uses worth to constrain origin.
Local gains are not progress toward a fixed highest endpoint.
Do not infer Greek word-frequency from a disputed translated chance expression.
The authorial act and the moving subject both prevent a final self-portrait.

independent_review_corrections.before: The further thing is precisely that unaddressed “is.”
independent_review_corrections.after: The further thing is precisely that “is” with no address attached.

independent_review_corrections.before: This side cannot follow that sentence. What it cannot follow is not every statement about the self. It can make the addressed kind: at this level, in this matter, this is what governs. It cannot make the unaddressed kind: the unconditional, final “is” that says everything about a whole person.
independent_review_corrections.after: This side cannot follow that sentence. What it cannot follow is not every statement about the self. It can make the kind with an address attached: at this level, in this matter, this is what governs. It cannot make the kind without one: the unconditional, final “is” that says everything about a whole person.

findings: Restored the exact 54-paragraph scope: three question marks, Theognis attachment, diagnosis before any legal prescription, childhood fear/shame comparison, explicit failure conditions, and the reader-motivation gap. Removed old English extension into law, coercion dangers, political constitutions and institutional prescriptions that this essay expressly leaves to other essays.
anchors: The two opening branches remain questions; the argument begins in the next sentence.
Fear of punishment describes how people are moved; this passage has not prescribed law or force.
Both books hand themselves over, but one moves beyond argument and the other relies on it.
SAE does have failure conditions; the missing part is motivating reviewers to arrive, not procedural openness.
Self-sufficiency is denied to argument alone, not to argument’s value.

independent_review_corrections.before: Or, as people say, is the end in practical matters not to contemplate and understand each thing, but to do it? With virtue too, knowing is not enough: must we try to possess and use it, or find some other means of becoming good?
independent_review_corrections.after: Or, as people say, is the end in practical matters not to contemplate and understand each thing but to do it, and must we, in the case of virtue too, go beyond knowing to try to possess and use it, or find some other means of becoming good?

corrections: EP11 paragraph 53: restored Aristotle himself as the one who cannot answer, rather than the question being unable to answer itself.
EP13 paragraph 5: kept the second branch as one question, preserving the later third-question count.
EP12 paragraphs 47/55: spelled out address attached/absent to avoid unaddressed being misread as not yet dealt with.
